name: fontview
desc: Free, open-source font viewer for Windows — preview, compare and manage installed fonts offline. 100 MB portable, no ads, MIT.
features: ✅ **Grid preview of everything** — all installed fonts rendered with your sample text, no clicking one by one
✅ **Custom sample text** — type the actual project string so you judge real copy, not a pangram
✅ **Compare mode** — up to four fonts side by side at identical sizes for close calls
✅ **Glyph browser** — full character map per font including Cyrillic, Greek and symbols coverage
✅ **Filter and sort** — narrow by weight, width, serif or script; sort by family or install date
✅ **Install and remove** — mount a folder of font files for preview and install selectively
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, portable, offline, MIT with SHA-256 releases
compare: | Custom sample text in grid | **Yes** | Yes | Partial | One line |
| Four-font compare mode | **Yes** | Partial | No | No |
| Glyph coverage browser | **Yes** | Yes | No | No |
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | Installer | Zip | With OS |
faqQ: how to preview all fonts on Windows quickly?
faqA: Windows font preview opens one file at a time behind three dialogs, which is unusable when picking a pairing from 300 installed families. fontview tiles every font with your own sample text, compares finalists side by side, and shows glyph coverage before you commit. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, offline with no ads.
s1: Dark type grid (#121417, violet #A78BFA): six font tiles per row rendering the sample text, size slider at 28 px, filter chips serif and sans.
s2: Compare mode: four columns with the same sentence, spacing and weight labels above, winner star on the second column.
s3: Glyph browser: character table for the selected font, Cyrillic block complete, missing glyphs grayed, install button bottom right.
